$meta.direction: Deep field - addition C: Neighbourhood explorer
$meta.note: Additions only, same shape as design/tokens.json. Contrast ratios are WCAG 2 ratios against the theme background (#090C12 dark, #F4F5F8 light), computed. Light values are proposals: no light artboard was drawn for C.

ringGuide.use: ring circles and the direction divider. Decorative

edge.use: resting edge. Brighter than galaxy.edge (1.9) on purpose: here the edges are the content, so they must pass 3:1

eventNode.note: borderline: the diamond shape carries it

ring.r2: 260px: grouped kinds (pages and codeunits, extensions, subscribers) as pills
ring.arc: top 60 degrees at r2: Learn pages, videos, posts

neighbourhood.direction: right half = the centre points to it (relates to); left half = it points to the centre (referenced by). Never mixed
neighbourhood.overflow: one '+ n more' pill per ring side; opens the full list in the panel, grouped by system
neighbourhood.nodeColour: system colour of the neighbour (color.system), always with its label

edgeStyle.extends: double line (3px stroke with 1px background stroke inside)

neighbourhood.expand: one neighbour at a time; its own top 2 neighbours plus a count fan out 90px beyond the ring; expanding another collapses the first

perPageDiagram.content: centre + top neighbour per ring (max 5) + total link count
perPageDiagram.render: inline SVG written at build time, no script

ringFill.use: loading: rings draw at once, nodes fade in ring by ring

recentre.use: selected neighbour slides to the centre, old centre slides to its ring position. Same curve as panelSlide

motion.reducedMotion: re-centre is a cut; nodes appear without fading
